basic_details.job_title: TISS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Academic Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office for International Affairs (OIA) of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai, is filling two non-teaching "Temporary Staff" posts on contract, Academic Manager and International Research and Programme Manager (1 post each), at Rs. 60,000/- to 65,000/- commensurate with qualifications and experience. The initial tenure is one year. A Master's degree and a minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience are required. Applications are online through the "Apply Now" link on www.tiss.ac.in and must be received by 30 November 2026.

important_dates.joining: Selected candidates are expected to join within 15 days of their selection

qualification.details: PhD completed or thesis submitted in the area of social work, social sciences, humanities, International Relations, Public Relations, Management Studies, MBA, education or any related discipline. High proficiency in communication; oral and written skills, computer application/data management. Good interpersonal skills and ability to interface with various stakeholders: students, faculty members, staff at all levels. Excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with diverse groups of individuals. Experience of working with faculty members and international universities/academic institutions.

how_to_apply: Applications are online only. The notice asks candidates to:
Apply through the "Apply Now" link provided along with the advertisement on the Institute's website, www.tiss.ac.in.
Complete the online application form and upload all required documents.

Pay the application fee online: Rs 500/- for General and OBC candidates; Rs. 125/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates who attach the required certificate with the application form; women applicants are waived from the fee.
After successful submission, download and retain a printout of the acknowledgement/confirmation of the online application.

The application is valid only on receipt of the application fee, if applicable. Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. The notice does not list the individual documents to upload.
important_instructions: The Institute reserves the right not to fill the vacancy advertised. No queries or correspondence regarding call letters for interview/selection will be entertained at any stage. Canvassing will lead to the candidate being debarred from consideration for the post. No TA/DA is payable for appearing in the written test and/or interview. The selected candidate will have to join within a reasonable time from the date of selection.

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences is a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a grant-in-aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, with its main campus in Mumbai. The Office for International Affairs promotes international academic exchange and collaboration between TISS and foreign higher education institutions, and facilitates MoUs and agreements. This is a government-aided institute recruitment on contract, not a regular post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in social work, Social Sciences, Humanities, International Relations, Management Studies, MBA, Education, or any related discipline.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay for both posts is Rs. 60,000/- to 65,000/-, commensurate with qualifications and experience. The appointment is temporary, on a contract basis, for an initial period of one year. It may be extended based on the candidate's performance and the Institute's requirements. If services are extended, the appointed candidates will be paid an annual increment of 5% of their remuneration.

content_sections.heading: TISS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Academic Manager will oversee the academic planning, coordination and implementation of Dual Degree programmes and short-term international academic programmes. Key responsibilities: Overseeing and coordinating academic and field work activities of the Dual Degree programmes/short term international programs and Global Classrooms/Collaborative online programmes. Contribute to the conceptualisation, development and implementation of new international academic programmes and initiatives under the TISS Global-Center for Global Studies. Support the overall academic administration and coordination of the Office for International Affairs. Coordinate with faculty for preparation and publication of semester course schedules. Scheduling classes, booking classrooms, organising academic events, and communicating relevant information with students and faculty members. Support course and credit mapping between TISS and international partner institutions and maintain programme-wise academic records. Serve as a liaison between faculty, students, and administrative offices to address academic-related inquiries and resolve issues. Monitor academic progress and support student advising efforts by maintaining academic records and identifying students needing additional support. Organise academic events such as orientation sessions, workshops, and meetings in collaboration with the OIA team. Ensure compliance with institutional academic policies and accreditation standards. Manage academic calendar deadlines, including registration, grading, and course evaluations. Compile and analyse academic data for reporting purposes. Help OIA in the management of administration of affiliated international students/staff and faculty; documentation of regular activities. Support Dual Degree Students to plan and manage applications to international partner universities, guide them through visa applications, accommodation and travel arrangements. Advising international groups on immigration, accommodation and other logistical support. Actively participate in coordination and management of overall administration of the Office for International Affairs. This post will develop and manage international research projects and partnerships, support faculty in establishing new research collaborations, and oversee programme implementation, documentation, reporting and outcomes. Key responsibilities: Lead and coordinate international research projects, programmes and collaborative academic initiatives undertaken by the Office for International Affairs. Develop and coordinate new international research collaborations, academic programmes and institutional partnerships with universities, research institutions and other international organisations. Design and conceptualise various programme for proposed TISS Global Dialogues.
